reports.title: Barbara Mayer
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: The Trust is planning to review the functions of the CRHT over the forthcoming months. Included within this review will be how we can improve the consistency of staff engaged with the service user. | would like to provide you with an update on progress in early September.
promises.summary: Review CRHT consistency and escalation plans

concerns.quote: mG was noted to show signs of Carer fatigue, but this was not followed up

Although seen regularly by the Crisis Team, Mrs Mayer was seen by a number of different people as a result of which no trusting relationship could be established. She had to repeat her history at each visit to a different person about personal matters
Different treatments were offered to Mrs Mayer without the reasoning or their efficacy being discussed with her
Mrs Mayer required help urgently on 14 November 2014 but due to an increase in demand no one was available to see her until 16 November 2014

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that patients were seen by numerous different staff members, preventing a trusting relationship and requiring them to repeat their personal history. This lack of continuity of care is the core concern in each case.
